coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K03. Commercial guides give minimum wage TT$20.50/hour since Jan 2024 and NIS combined rate 16.2% from Jan 2026 (19.2% scheduled Jan 2027); both from non-official sources (unverified). No official source found on household-employer NIS steps or a domestic-worker contract rule.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Scrap Metal Act 2022 partly proclaimed 24 Feb 2023. Dealer licence Form 3A plus Forms 3B, 5 and 6 (AML questionnaire), TT$500. 31 licensed sites as of late 2024; no new dealer licences issued then. Collector registration (s.3(1)) still not proclaimed as of Dec 2024. 7 days' written notice needed before export. Dealers were shown TTBizLink and DevelopTT. Candidate C2 listed.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnbrokers Act Chap. 84:05 (annual licence by magistrate/licensing committee). Ministers repeatedly extended time periods under s.32A (LN 30/2024, LN 142/2024), so pawnbroker compliance is in flux. No separate second-hand dealer Act found. Candidate C5 listed.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Licensing of Dealers (Precious Metals and Stones) Act Chap. 84:06: annual magistrate licence expiring 31 Dec, with extension orders (LN 27/2024, LN 140/2024). Jewellers are probably also FIUTT-listed, so this is close to K02. Candidate C5 listed.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No licensing regime for dismantlers or parts dealers found. A letter in the Express calls for garage licensing. The Trade Licence Unit licences foreign-used vehicle importers only. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Only the Animals (Importation) Control Regulations (Chap. 67:02) came up. No domestic livestock movement permit or livestock trader licence found. Unverified.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Veterinary Public Health Unit (Ministry of Health) inspects abattoirs, poultry processors and further processors and trains butchers. No butcher licence or abattoir licence or register source found. Unverified.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Nothing found in the combined vendors/beekeepers search. No beekeeper registration rule located. Unverified.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Veterinary Surgeons (Registration) Act Chap. 67:04 covers practitioners only. No rule found on veterinary drug seller licensing; CFDD drug portal exists but scope for veterinary products unknown. Unverified.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: WRA (WASA) forms: LG1.1 permission to drill a private well, LG1.3 well completion report issued with the drillers' licence, LG1.4 abstraction licence for a well, LS1 surface licence, L5 renewal. Water Pollution Rules 2019 (LN 312) apply to groundwater. Candidate C6 listed.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Waste Management Rules 2021 cover transport and collection of waste, and the CEC regime has a National Register. Could not confirm what hauler registration or permit is needed or the fees. Candidate C7 listed as unverified.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: The one search returned only foreign (Malaysia, Queensland) results. No T&T source found for OSH Act 2004 pressure-vessel or lift registration. Needs a second, narrower search.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No search spent (budget). Only the WRA abstraction forms were seen (see 10).

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Pesticides and Toxic Chemicals Act 1979 with Board. Pesticides (Licensing of Premises) Regulations 1987 licence sale, storage, packaging and manufacture, with inspection and licence display. s.4A (1986 amendment) requires a licence for pest control operators. Import licences carry record-keeping duties. Registrar said amendments are being considered. A survey says enforcement is weak. Candidate C4 listed.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Recruiting of Workers Act Chap. 88:10 requires recruiters to be licensed (amended Act 3 of 2007). No 2025 changes found. Candidate C8 listed as weak.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Burial Grounds Act Chap. 30:50 (private burial ground licence, 30-year term). Funeral Homes Bill 2000 lapsed; no funeral-home licensing law. 2025 Cumuto cemetery scandal (56 unclaimed bodies) revived calls from the funeral association to regulate. Cemetery Bill 2024 reported passed (source seen only as a radio headline, country unconfirmed). Candidate C9 listed.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Non-Profit Organisations Act 2019. Registrar General flagged 3,000+ NPOs for not filing Form 6 (annual return, due within 30 days of anniversary since 14 Oct 2024). Suspension was set for 28 Apr 2026 and cancellation for 28 May 2026, then postponed per a Cropper Foundation letter (postponement notice not seen). Many NPOs thought the old Form 29 was enough. Filing is via TTConnect. Candidate C1 listed. No halal/kosher supervision sources searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Maxi taxi PBR permits renewed annually by online appointment (Priority Bus Route Unit, Ministry of Transport/Works). Needs certified ownership copy, inspection certificate, operator's permit, defensive driving certificate, valid taxi badge, driver's permit, insurance and registration copy. 'PBR Maxi Taxi Renewal 2026' notice exists on mtca.gov.tt (contents not seen). Taxi badge needs medical and good-character certificates. Candidate C3 listed.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Municipal vendor licensing bill (2001) seen; pedlar and hawker ordinances are old. MTTI vendor regularisation at Maracas Beach runs to Oct 2026 (food vendors already done). Nothing found on money changers. Candidate C10 listed as weak.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Nurseries: Children's Community Residences, Foster Homes and Nurseries Act 65 of 2000, Part V (licence, inspection, penalties). The Ministry of Education ECCE Division handles early childhood centres, and no 2024 ECCE Act was found. No tattoo, driving-school or hunting rules found. Small food producers and hunting outfitters not searched. Candidate C11 listed.

coverage.category: 34. OSH Act workplace registration and enforcement
coverage.found: OSH Agency enforces the OSH Act 2004; a 2025 Privy Council ruling applies the 6-month limit in s.93 to all prosecutions; no registration deadline found. Candidate C13 (weak, unverified).

coverage.category: 35. Cannabis Control Act 2022 licensing
coverage.found: Act No. 10 of 2022 sets up a licensing authority (cultivation, processing, retail, import, export, transport); commencement unconfirmed; no licence counts found. Candidate C14 (unverified).

coverage.category: 36. 2026 legislative agenda: Firearms Reform Bill and Miscellaneous Provisions (Alcohol, Cannabis, Dangerous Drugs, Gambling, Tobacco) Bill 2026
coverage.found: Both announced in the 2026 agenda per Guardian; one-line summaries only (stricter firearms control; age limits for sales). No text or dates. Candidate C15 (unverified).

coverage.category: 37. Tobago House of Assembly rules (Tobago-specific tourism/licensing)
coverage.found: No search run on THA-specific rules; only the Tobago share of short-term rental stock was seen under category 29.
